description.zh: 下载次数。取值范围为整数。
description.en: The number of times that the shared files are downloaded. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0.

description.zh: 分享下载次数限制。取值范围为整数，取值为0时表示不限制。
description.en: The limit on the number of times that the shared files can be downloaded. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0. The value 0 specifies that no limit is imposed on the number of times that the shared files can be downloaded.

description.zh: 失效时间点。 RFC3339格式。 当取值为空时，表示永久有效。
description.en: The time when the file sharing link expires. The value of this parameter follows the RFC 3339 standard. Example: "2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00". If this parameter is set to "", the file sharing link never expires.

description.zh: 预览次数。取值范围为整数。
description.en: The number of times that the shared files are previewed. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0.

description.zh: 分享预览次数限制。取值范围为整数，取值为0时表示不限制。
description.en: The limit on the number of times that the shared files can be previewed. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0. The value 0 specifies that no limit is imposed on the number of times that the shared files can be downloaded.

description.zh: 举报次数。取值范围为整数。
description.en: The number of times that the shared files are reported. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0.

description.zh: 转存次数。取值范围为整数。
description.en: The number of times that the shared files are dumped. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0.

description.zh: 分享转存次数限制。取值范围为整数，取值为0时表示不限制。
description.en: The limit on the number of times that the shared files can be dumped. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0. The value 0 specifies that no limit is imposed on the number of times that the shared files can be downloaded.
The ID of the file sharing task.

description.zh: 分享名。 如果未设置，默认使用`file_id_list`中的第一个ID对应的文件名。 长度范围为0\~128个字符。
description.en:
The name of the file sharing task. If you do not configure this parameter, the sharing task name is the first ID that is returned in the file_id_list value.

>  The sharing task name must be 0 to 128 characters in length.

description.zh: 提取码长度范围：0\~64字节。不设置或者设置为空，表示无提取码，在获取分享令牌的时候也不用设置提取码参数。 要求使用ASCII可见字符。
description.en: The length of the access code. Valid values: 6 to 8. Unit: bytes. If you leave this parameter empty or set it to null, no access code is required. If you use a token to share files, you do not need to configure this parameter. The access code can contain only visible ASCII characters.

The sharing status.

Valid values:

*   disabled: The sharing task is canceled.

    <!-- -->

*   enabled: The sharing task is valid.

description.zh: 视频预览次数。取值范围为整数。
description.en: The number of times that the videos are previewed in the shared files. The value of this parameter must be equal to or greater than 0.
